Name: Scooby's Snacks
Author: QueenQuackin
Description:
**Scooby Doo is owned by Warner Bro's**

[size=4]Has your farmer ever wondered what a Scooby Snack tastes like? Well they are in luck! With the big heart that Scooby has he decided to share the recipe with them!

The recipe can be purchased in the Adventurer Guild after reaching level 10 in both Mining and Combat![/size]

[size=4]If you want to see the Buffs and Stats be sure to check out the articles tab

[/size][size=6]Happy Snacking!

[/size][size=4]If you encounter any errors please report them to the bug section so that I will be notified. When reporting a bug please make sure to explain the problem and add your [url=https://smapi.io/log]Smapi Log[/url]!

For Translators - If you wish to translate the little bit that is in this mod please message me the translation and I will add it to the mod and give you proper credit. [b][i]DO NOT UPLOAD YOUR OWN MOD

[/i][/b]For NPC Mod Authors - If you wish to add Scooby's Snacks to your NPC's gift tastes I would love that. You can either link this mod in your description or add it as a dependency if you choose. Please also let me know! I will happily add your npc to the list :)

[/size][size=6][b][i][u]Current Supported Languages[/u][/i][/b]
English

[b][i][u]NPC Gift Tastes
[/u][/i][/b][/size]**Vanilla Characters soon to come**
